function repairLocalUserPasswords(users){
  const defaults=defaultUsers();
  const byId=new Map(defaults.map(u=>[u.id,u]));
  const byLogin=new Map(defaults.map(u=>[u.login,u]));
  return (Array.isArray(users)?users:[]).map(u=>{
    if(u&&String(u.senha||'')!=='')return u;
    const d=byId.get(u?.id)||byLogin.get(u?.login);
    return d?{...u,senha:d.senha}:u;
  });
}
function mergeUsersPreservingPasswords(localUsers,remoteUsers){
  const local=Array.isArray(localUsers)?localUsers:[];
  const remote=Array.isArray(remoteUsers)?remoteUsers:[];
  if(!remote.length)return repairLocalUserPasswords(local.length?local:defaultUsers());
  const localById=new Map(local.filter(Boolean).map(u=>[u.id,u]));
  const localByLogin=new Map(local.filter(Boolean).map(u=>[u.login,u]));
  return repairLocalUserPasswords(remote.map(r=>{
    const l=localById.get(r?.id)||localByLogin.get(r?.login);
    return {...r,...(l&&String(l.senha||'')!==''?{senha:l.senha}:{})};
  }));
}

function normalizeUserOperational(u){

  if(u.ativo===undefined)u.ativo=true;
  if(!u.id)u.id='u-'+Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(16).slice(2);

}

function goTab(id, opts={}){
  if((id==='configuracoes'||id==='relatorios')&&!isAdmin()){openAppConfirm({title:'Área restrita',message:'Área liberada apenas para usuários Admin.',okText:'OK'});return;}
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab,.footerNav button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.tab===id));
  document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s=>s.classList.toggle('active',s.id===id));
  if(!opts.silent){
    try{sessionStorage.setItem('pp_last_tab',id);localStorage.setItem('pp_last_tab',id);}catch(e){}
  }
  if(id==='configuracoes')setTimeout(renderStorageHealth,100);
}
document.querySelectorAll('.tab,.footerNav button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>goTab(b.dataset.tab));

function normalizeUserOperational(u){
  if(!u)return u;
  if(u.ativo===undefined)u.ativo=true;
  if(!u.id)u.id='u-'+Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(16).slice(2);
  if(!u.perfil)u.perfil='portaria';
  if(u.perfil==='admin'&&!u.turno)u.turno='administracao';
  if(u.perfil==='zelador'&&!u.turno)u.turno='zeladoria';
  if(u.perfil==='portaria'&&!u.turno)u.turno='';
  return u;
}
function userProfileLabel(u){
  const p=String(u?.perfil||'portaria').toLowerCase();
  const t=String(u?.turno||'').toLowerCase();
  if(p==='admin')return 'Admin / Síndico';
  if(p==='zelador')return 'Zelador';
  if(t==='dia')return 'Portaria Dia';
  if(t==='noite')return 'Portaria Noite';
  return 'Portaria';
}
function userProfileBadgeClass(u){
  const p=String(u?.perfil||'portaria').toLowerCase();
  const t=String(u?.turno||'').toLowerCase();
  if(p==='admin')return 'admin';
  if(p==='zelador')return 'zelador';
  if(t==='dia')return 'portariaDia';
  if(t==='noite')return 'portariaNoite';
  return 'portaria';
}
function userTurnoLabel(t){
  return ({dia:'Portaria Dia',noite:'Portaria Noite',zeladoria:'Zeladoria',administracao:'Administração'}[t]||'Sem turno definido');
}
function userLastAccessLabel(u){
  if(!u?.lastAccessAt)return 'Nunca acessou';
  try{return 'Último acesso: '+new Date(u.lastAccessAt).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}catch(e){return 'Último acesso registrado'}
}


const ADMIN_ACCORDION_MEMORY_KEY='pp_admin_accordion_state_v1';
function getAdminAccordionMemory(){
  try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(ADMIN_ACCORDION_MEMORY_KEY)||'{}')||{}}catch(e){return{}}
}
function setAdminAccordionMemory(data){
  try{localStorage.setItem(ADMIN_ACCORDION_MEMORY_KEY,JSON.stringify(data||{}))}catch(e){}
}
function saveAdminAccordionState(){
  if(window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(max-width:760px)').matches)return;
  const data={};
  document.querySelectorAll('.adminAccordion[data-accordion-key]').forEach(card=>{
    data[card.dataset.accordionKey]=!card.classList.contains('collapsed');
  });
  setAdminAccordionMemory(data);
}
function applyAdminAccordionMemory(){
  if(window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(max-width:760px)').matches)return;
  const data=getAdminAccordionMemory();
  const keys=Object.keys(data);
  if(!keys.length)return;
  document.querySelectorAll('.adminAccordion[data-accordion-key]').forEach(card=>{
    const key=card.dataset.accordionKey;
    if(!(key in data))return;
    const open=!!data[key];
    card.classList.toggle('collapsed',!open);
    card.classList.toggle('open',open);
    card.querySelector('.adminAccordionTop')?.classList.add('memoryRestored');
  });
  updateAdminAccordionSummaries?.();
}
function toggleAdminAccordion(card){
  if(!card)return;
  if(window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(max-width:760px)').matches)return;
  card.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  card.classList.toggle('open',!card.classList.contains('collapsed'));
  saveAdminAccordionState();
  updateAdminAccordionSummaries?.();
}
function openAllAdminAccordions(){
  if(window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(max-width:760px)').matches)return;
  document.querySelectorAll('.adminAccordion[data-accordion-key]').forEach(card=>{
    card.classList.remove('collapsed');
    card.classList.add('open');
  });
  saveAdminAccordionState();
  updateAdminAccordionSummaries?.();
}
function collapseAllAdminAccordions(){
  if(window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(max-width:760px)').matches)return;
  document.querySelectorAll('.adminAccordion[data-accordion-key]').forEach(card=>{
    card.classList.add('collapsed');
    card.classList.remove('open');
  });
  saveAdminAccordionState();
  updateAdminAccordionSummaries?.();
}

function load(){
  try{
    const raw=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY))||{};
    const base=initial();
    const data={...base,...raw};
    data.accesses=Array.isArray(data.accesses)?data.accesses:[];
    data.units=data.units&&typeof data.units==='object'?data.units:{};
    data.settings={...base.settings,...(data.settings||{})};
    data.operational=Array.isArray(data.operational)?data.operational:[];
    data.users=repairLocalUserPasswords(Array.isArray(data.users)&&data.users.length?data.users:defaultUsers());
    const migratedAdmin=data.users.find(u=>u&&(u.id==='u-admin'||u.login==='admin')); if(migratedAdmin&&!String(migratedAdmin.email||'').trim())migratedAdmin.email='c.edu.cunha1977@gmail.com';
    data.logs=Array.isArray(data.logs)?data.logs:[];
    data.comunicados=Array.isArray(data.comunicados)?data.comunicados:[];
    data.users.forEach(u=>normalizeUserOperational(u));
    return data;
  }catch(e){console.warn('Falha ao carregar base local',e);return initial()}
}
function save(syncReason='alteracao'){
  normalizeAccesses();
  touchStateMeta(syncReason);
  localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(state));
  const st=document.getElementById('saveStatus');
  if(st)st.textContent='Salvo às '+new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
  renderAll();
  scheduleCloudAutoBackup();
  queueCloudSyncPush(syncReason);
}

function updateAdminAccordionSummaries(){
  const users=state.users||[];
  const active=users.filter(u=>u.ativo!==false).length;
  const admins=users.filter(u=>u.perfil==='admin'&&u.ativo!==false).length;
  const portaria=users.filter(u=>u.perfil==='portaria'&&u.ativo!==false).length;
  const zelador=users.filter(u=>u.perfil==='zelador'&&u.ativo!==false).length;
  const us=document.getElementById('usersAccordionSummary');
  if(us)us.innerHTML=`<b>${active}</b> ativos • <b>${admins}</b> admin • <b>${portaria}</b> portaria • <b>${zelador}</b> zelador`;
  const logs=state.logs||[];
  const last=logs[0];
  const hs=document.getElementById('historyAccordionSummary');
  if(hs)hs.innerHTML=last?`Último registro: <b>${esc(last.usuarioNome||last.usuario||'Sistema')}</b> — ${esc(last.acao||'Ação')} • ${esc(logWhenShort?.(last.criadoEm)||'')}`:'Nenhum registro ainda.';
  const ls=document.getElementById('logsAccordionSummary');
  if(ls)ls.innerHTML=logs.length?`<b>${logs.length}</b> registros técnicos • último em ${esc(logWhenShort?.(last?.criadoEm)||'—')}`:'Nenhum log técnico registrado.';
}

function renderOperationalIdentityPanel(){
  const box=document.getElementById('operatorIdentityPanel');
  if(!box)return;
  const u=getCurrentUser?.();
  const active=(state.users||[]).filter(x=>x.ativo!==false);
  if(!u){box.innerHTML='<div class="mini">Nenhum operador conectado.</div>';return;}
  const options=active.map(x=>`<option value="${escAttr(x.login)}" ${x.login===u.login?'selected':''}>${esc(x.nome||x.login)} — ${esc(userProfileLabel(x))}</option>`).join('');
  box.innerHTML=`<div class="operatorIdentityMain">
    <div class="operatorAvatar">🛡️</div>
    <div class="operatorIdentityText">
      <b>Operador atual: ${esc(u.nome||u.login)}</b>
      <span>${esc(userProfileLabel(u))} • ${esc(userTurnoLabel(u.turno||''))} • ${esc(u.login||'')}</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="operatorQuickSwitch">
    <label>Troca rápida para teste<select id="quickOperatorSelect">${options}</select></label>
    <button class="btn ghost" onclick="quickSwitchOperator()">Trocar</button>
  </div>`;
}

}

/* Rotação de acessos: mantém todos "Dentro" + últimos N dias de concluídos */
function rotateAccesses(){
  const cutoff=Date.now()-ROTATION_ACCESSES_DAYS*86400000;
  const antes=(state.accesses||[]).length;
  const arquivados=(state.accesses||[]).filter(a=>{
    if(!a.saida) return false; // sempre manter ativos
    const ts=new Date(a.saida||a.createdAt||0).getTime();
    return ts < cutoff;
  });
  if(!arquivados.length) return {removidos:0,antes};
  // Arquivar no Supabase antes de remover (silencioso)
  if(cloudReady&&supabaseClient&&arquivados.length){
    const payload={tipo:'arquivo_acessos',gerado_em:new Date().toISOString(),quantidade:arquivados.length,dados:arquivados};
    supabaseClient.from('snapshots').insert({descricao:`Arquivo acessos antigos (>${ROTATION_ACCESSES_DAYS}d) — ${arquivados.length} registros`,dados:payload}).then(({error})=>{
      if(error)console.warn('Falha ao arquivar acessos no Supabase',error);
    });
  }
  state.accesses=(state.accesses||[]).filter(a=>{
    if(!a.saida) return true;
    const ts=new Date(a.saida||a.createdAt||0).getTime();
    return ts >= cutoff;
  });
  return {removidos:arquivados.length,antes};
}

/* Rotação de logs: cap por quantidade e por idade */
function rotateLogs(){
  const antes=(state.logs||[]).length;
  const cutoff=Date.now()-ROTATION_LOGS_DAYS*86400000;
  state.logs=(state.logs||[]).filter(l=>new Date(l.criadoEm||0).getTime()>=cutoff);
  if(state.logs.length>ROTATION_LOGS_MAX) state.logs=state.logs.slice(0,ROTATION_LOGS_MAX);
  return {removidos:antes-state.logs.length,antes};
}

/* Executa rotação completa */
function runRotation(manual=false){
  const ra=rotateAccesses();
  const rl=rotateLogs();
  const total=ra.removidos+rl.removidos;
  localStorage.setItem(ROTATION_KEY,new Date().toISOString());
  if(total>0||manual){
    localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(state));
    if(total>0) addLog('Rotação automática de dados',
      `Acessos removidos: ${ra.removidos} (>${ROTATION_ACCESSES_DAYS}d) · Logs removidos: ${rl.removidos} (>${ROTATION_LOGS_DAYS}d ou >${ROTATION_LOGS_MAX})`,
      'sistema');
    if(manual){
      renderStorageHealth();
      const used=storageUsedKB();
      showCloudToast(`Rotação concluída · ${total} registros arquivados · ${used} KB em uso`,'ok',6000);
    }
  } else if(manual){
    renderStorageHealth();
    showCloudToast('Storage saudável — nenhum dado para arquivar ✅','ok',4000);
  }
}

/* Rotação automática na inicialização (só se passaram 24h desde a última) */
function maybeRunRotation(){
  const last=localStorage.getItem(ROTATION_KEY);
  const elapsed=last?Date.now()-new Date(last).getTime():Infinity;
  if(elapsed>86400000) runRotation(false); // roda se passaram mais de 24h
}

  state.accesses=(state.accesses||[]).filter(a=>{
    if(!a.saida) return true;
    const ts=new Date(a.saida||a.createdAt||0).getTime();
    return ts >= cutoff;
  });
  return {removidos:arquivados.length,antes};
}

/* Rotação de logs: cap por quantidade e por idade */
function rotateLogs(){
  const antes=(state.logs||[]).length;
  const cutoff=Date.now()-ROTATION_LOGS_DAYS*86400000;
  state.logs=(state.logs||[]).filter(l=>new Date(l.criadoEm||0).getTime()>=cutoff);
  if(state.logs.length>ROTATION_LOGS_MAX) state.logs=state.logs.slice(0,ROTATION_LOGS_MAX);
  return {removidos:antes-state.logs.length,antes};
}

/* Executa rotação completa */
function runRotation(manual=false){
  const ra=rotateAccesses();
  const rl=rotateLogs();
  const total=ra.removidos+rl.removidos;
  localStorage.setItem(ROTATION_KEY,new Date().toISOString());
  if(total>0||manual){
    localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(state));
    if(total>0) addLog('Rotação automática de dados',
      `Acessos removidos: ${ra.removidos} (>${ROTATION_ACCESSES_DAYS}d) · Logs removidos: ${rl.removidos} (>${ROTATION_LOGS_DAYS}d ou >${ROTATION_LOGS_MAX})`,
      'sistema');
    if(manual){
      renderStorageHealth();
      const used=storageUsedKB();
      showCloudToast(`Rotação concluída · ${total} registros arquivados · ${used} KB em uso`,'ok',6000);
    }
  } else if(manual){
    renderStorageHealth();
    showCloudToast('Storage saudável — nenhum dado para arquivar ✅','ok',4000);
  }
}

/* Rotação automática na inicialização (só se passaram 24h desde a última) */
function maybeRunRotation(){
  const last=localStorage.getItem(ROTATION_KEY);
  const elapsed=last?Date.now()-new Date(last).getTime():Infinity;
  if(elapsed>86400000) runRotation(false); // roda se passaram mais de 24h
}

function crc32(str){
  let crc=0xFFFFFFFF;
  for(let i=0;i<str.length;i++){
    crc^=str.charCodeAt(i);
    for(let j=0;j<8;j++) crc=(crc>>>1)^(crc&1?0xEDB88320:0);
  }
  return((crc^0xFFFFFFFF)>>>0).toString(16).padStart(8,'0');
}

  const v=validateBackup(snap.payload); if(!v.ok){openAppConfirm({title:'Snapshot inválido',message:v.msg,okText:'OK'});return;}
  openAppConfirm({title:'Restaurar snapshot local?',message:`Snapshot de <b>${formatWhenBR(snap.createdAt)}</b><br>Motivo: <b>${esc(snap.reason||'manual')}</b><br>Checksum: <b>${esc(snap.checksum||'—')}</b><br><br>A base atual será substituída. Um snapshot de segurança será criado antes.`,okText:'Restaurar',onConfirm:()=>{createLocalSnapshot('antes-restaurar-snapshot',true); applyBackupData(snap.payload,{name:'snapshot-local-'+(snap.createdAt||'')+'.json'}); showCloudToast?.('Snapshot restaurado ✅','ok',4500); refreshBackupCenterStatus?.();}})
}
function openLocalSnapshots(){
  const list=getLocalSnapshots();
  if(!list.length){openAppConfirm({title:'Histórico local',message:'Ainda não há snapshots locais. Clique em <b>Criar snapshot</b> antes de importações ou alterações grandes.',okText:'OK'});return;}
  const html=`<div class="snapshotList">${list.map(s=>`<div class="snapshotItem"><div><b>${esc(formatWhenBR(s.createdAt))}</b><div class="snapshotMeta">${esc(s.reason||'manual')} • ${esc(s.createdBy||'Sistema')} • checksum ${esc(s.checksum||'—')}</div></div><button class="btn ghost adminOnly" onclick="restoreLocalSnapshot('${escAttr(s.id)}')">Restaurar</button></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
  openAppConfirm({title:`Snapshots locais (${list.length})`,message:html,okText:'Fechar',onConfirm:()=>{}});
}

function refreshBackupCenterStatus(){
  const counts=backupCounts();
  const localStatus=document.getElementById('backupLocalStatus'), localDetail=document.getElementById('backupLocalDetail');
  if(localStatus)localStatus.textContent='Local ativo';
  if(localDetail)localDetail.textContent=`${counts.unidades} unidades • ${counts.acessos} acessos • ${counts.veiculos} veículos`;
  setRecoveryCard('backupLocalCard','ok');
  const supStatus=document.getElementById('backupSupabaseStatus'), supDetail=document.getElementById('backupSupabaseDetail');
  const syncAt=localStorage.getItem('pp_last_sync_at')||'';
  if(supStatus)supStatus.textContent=cloudReady?(syncRealtimeReady?'Tempo real ativo':'Sync ativo'):'Aguardando conexão';
  if(supDetail)supDetail.textContent=syncAt?`Última sync: ${formatWhenBR(syncAt)}`:'Ainda sem sync registrada nesta instalação';
  setRecoveryCard('backupSupabaseCard',cloudReady?'ok':'warn');
  const drvStatus=document.getElementById('backupDriveStatus'), drvDetail=document.getElementById('backupDriveDetail');
  if(drvStatus)drvStatus.textContent=_gdriveToken?'Drive conectado':'Drive não conectado';
  const lastDrive=localStorage.getItem('pp_last_gdrive_backup_at')||'';
  if(drvDetail)drvDetail.textContent=lastDrive?`Último Drive: ${formatWhenBR(lastDrive)}`:'Conecte para backup externo';
  setRecoveryCard('backupDriveCard',_gdriveToken?'ok':'warn');
  const health=document.getElementById('backupHealthStatus'), healthDetail=document.getElementById('backupHealthDetail');
  const lastSnap=localStorage.getItem('pp_last_local_snapshot_at')||'';
  if(health)health.textContent='Protegido';
  if(healthDetail)healthDetail.textContent=lastSnap?`Último snapshot: ${formatWhenBR(lastSnap)}`:'Crie snapshot antes de mudanças grandes';
  setRecoveryCard('backupHealthCard',lastSnap?'ok':'warn');
}
function crc32(str){
  let crc=0xFFFFFFFF;
  for(let i=0;i<str.length;i++){
    crc^=str.charCodeAt(i);
    for(let j=0;j<8;j++) crc=(crc>>>1)^(crc&1?0xEDB88320:0);
  }
  return((crc^0xFFFFFFFF)>>>0).toString(16).padStart(8,'0');
}

/* Gera o envelope de backup com metadados e checksum */
function buildBackupPayload(tipo='completo'){
  const now=new Date();
  let dados={};
  if(tipo==='completo')      dados={accesses:state.accesses,units:state.units,settings:state.settings,operational:state.operational,users:state.users.map(u=>({...u,senha:undefined})),logs:state.logs};
  else if(tipo==='moradores') dados={units:state.units};
  else if(tipo==='acessos')   dados={accesses:state.accesses};
  else if(tipo==='logs')      dados={logs:state.logs};

  const dadosStr=JSON.stringify(dados);
  return {
    _pp_backup:true,
    versao:'1.0',
    tipo,
    app:'Portaria Primavera',
    gerado_em:now.toISOString(),
    gerado_em_br:now.toLocaleString('pt-BR'),
    stats:{
      unidades:Object.keys(state.units||{}).length,
      acessos:(state.accesses||[]).length,
      logs:(state.logs||[]).length,
      usuarios:(state.users||[]).length,
    },
    checksum:crc32(dadosStr),
    dados
  };
}

/* Valida envelope de backup na importação */
function validateBackup(parsed){
  if(!parsed||typeof parsed!=='object') return {ok:false,msg:'Arquivo não é um JSON válido.'};
  // Formato antigo (state direto) — aceitar com aviso
  if(!parsed._pp_backup){
    if(parsed.accesses!==undefined||parsed.units!==undefined)
      return {ok:true,legado:true,msg:'Backup no formato antigo (sem metadados). Será importado com compatibilidade.'};
    return {ok:false,msg:'Arquivo não reconhecido como backup do Portaria Primavera.'};
  }
  // Formato novo — validar checksum
  const dadosStr=JSON.stringify(parsed.dados);
  const calc=crc32(dadosStr);
  if(calc!==parsed.checksum)
    return {ok:false,msg:`Checksum inválido — arquivo pode estar corrompido.\nEsperado: ${parsed.checksum}\nCalculado: ${calc}`};
  return {ok:true,legado:false,msg:''};
}

/* Aplica dados importados ao state */
function applyBackupData(parsed,file){
  const status=document.getElementById('backupStatus');
  let dados, tipo;
  if(parsed._pp_backup){
    dados=parsed.dados; tipo=parsed.tipo||'completo';
  } else {
    dados=parsed; tipo='completo'; // formato legado
  }
  if(tipo==='completo'){
    state={...initial(),...dados};
  } else if(tipo==='moradores'){
    state.units={...dados.units||{}};
  } else if(tipo==='acessos'){
    state.accesses=[...dados.accesses||[]];
  } else if(tipo==='logs'){
    state.logs=[...dados.logs||[]];
  }
  if(!Array.isArray(state.logs))state.logs=[];
  if(!Array.isArray(state.users)||!state.users.length)state.users=defaultUsers();
  state.users.forEach(u=>normalizeUserOperational(u));
  ensureSettings(); normalizeImportedVehicles?.(); normalizeAccesses?.();
  localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(state));
  addLog('Restaurou backup','Arquivo: '+file.name+' (tipo: '+tipo+')','backup');
  applyTheme(); renderAll(); applyPermissions();
  const info=parsed._pp_backup?` — gerado em ${parsed.gerado_em_br}`:'';
  if(status)status.textContent=`✅ Backup restaurado: ${file.name}${info}`;
}

function exportData(tipo='completo'){
  const payload=buildBackupPayload(tipo);
  const json=JSON.stringify(payload,null,2);
  const now=new Date();
  const dt=`${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  const sufixo=tipo==='completo'?'':'-'+tipo;
  const nome=`portaria-primavera${sufixo}-${dt}.json`;
  const blob=new Blob([json],{type:'application/json'});
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=url; a.download=nome; a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  addLog('Exportou backup',`Arquivo: ${nome} | Tipo: ${tipo} | Checksum: ${payload.checksum}`,'backup');
  persistNoRender(); renderLogs();
  showCloudToast(`Backup exportado: ${nome}`,'ok',4000);
  refreshBackupCenterStatus?.();
}

function restoreBackupFile(ev){
  const file=ev.target.files?.[0]; if(!file)return;
  const status=document.getElementById('backupStatus');
  const reader=new FileReader();
  reader.onload=e=>{
    try{
      const parsed=JSON.parse(e.target.result);
      const v=validateBackup(parsed);
      if(!v.ok){
        if(status)status.textContent='❌ '+v.msg;
        openAppConfirm({title:'Backup inválido',message:v.msg,okText:'OK'});
        return;
      }
      const aviso=v.legado?'<br><b>⚠ Formato antigo</b> — sem metadados de verificação.':'';
      const info=parsed._pp_backup
        ?`<b>Tipo:</b> ${parsed.tipo||'completo'}<br><b>Gerado em:</b> ${parsed.gerado_em_br}<br><b>Checksum:</b> ✅ verificado${aviso}`
        :`Backup no formato legado.${aviso}`;
      openAppConfirm({
        title:'Restaurar backup?',
        message:`${info}<br><br>A base atual será substituída. Deseja continuar?`,
        okText:'Restaurar',
        onConfirm:()=>{createLocalSnapshot('antes-restaurar-json',true); applyBackupData(parsed,file); refreshBackupCenterStatus?.();}
      });
    }catch(err){
      if(status)status.textContent='❌ Erro ao ler o arquivo JSON.';
      openAppConfirm({title:'Erro ao ler backup',message:'O arquivo não é um JSON válido ou está corrompido.',okText:'OK'});
    }finally{ev.target.value='';}
  };
  reader.readAsText(file);
}

async function testGDriveIntegrationConfig(){
  const cid=(document.getElementById('gdriveClientIdConfig')?.value||gdriveClientId()||'').trim();
  const key=(document.getElementById('gdriveApiKeyConfig')?.value||gdriveApiKey()||'').trim();
  if(!cid || !key){showCloudToast?.('Preencha Client ID e API Key antes de testar','err',5000);return;}
  setDriveStatus('⏳ Testando configuração do Google Drive...');
  try{
    const r=await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/discovery/v1/apis/drive/v3/rest?key='+encodeURIComponent(key));
    if(!r.ok)throw new Error('API Key recusada pelo Google ('+r.status+')');
    const j=await r.json();
    if(!j || !j.name)throw new Error('Resposta inesperada do Google Drive API');
    setDriveStatus('✅ Configuração válida. Agora conecte ao Google Drive.','ok');
    const st=document.getElementById('gdriveIntegrationStatus');
    if(st){st.className='integrationStatus ok';st.textContent='Configuração OK';}
    showCloudToast?.('Google Drive API validada ✅','ok',4000);
  }catch(e){
    setDriveStatus('❌ Falha no teste: '+e.message,'err');
    const st=document.getElementById('gdriveIntegrationStatus');
    if(st){st.className='integrationStatus err';st.textContent='Teste falhou';}
  }
}
function clearGDriveIntegrationConfig(){
  openAppConfirm({
    title:'Limpar integração Google Drive?',
    message:'Isso remove o Client ID, API Key e token salvo neste navegador. Os backups já criados no Drive não serão apagados.',

    onConfirm:()=>{
      localStorage.removeItem('pp_gdrive_client_id');

      _gdriveToken=null;

      gdriveUpdateUI?.(false);
      setDriveStatus('Google Drive desconectado e configuração removida.');
    }
  });
}

function gdriveConnect(){
  const clientId=gdriveClientId();
  if(!clientId){
    const hint=document.getElementById('driveClientIdHint'); if(hint)hint.style.display='';
    setDriveStatus('⚠ Google Drive não configurado. Preencha Central Administrativa → Integrações.','err');
    openAppConfirm({
      title:'Google Drive não configurado',
      message:'Para usar o Google Drive, preencha o <b>OAuth Client ID</b> e a <b>API Key</b> em <b>Central Administrativa → Integrações</b>.<br><br>Depois clique em <b>Conectar ao Google Drive</b> novamente.',
      okText:'Entendi',
      onConfirm:()=>{}
    });
    return;
  }
  const redirectUri=window.location.origin+window.location.pathname;
  const params=new URLSearchParams({
    client_id:clientId,
    redirect_uri:redirectUri,
    response_type:'token',
    scope:GDRIVE_SCOPE,
    prompt:'select_account'
  });
  const popup=window.open('https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?'+params,'gdrive_oauth','width=500,height=600,left=200,top=100');
  const check=setInterval(()=>{
    try{
      if(popup.closed){clearInterval(check);return;}
      const hash=popup.location.hash;
      if(hash&&hash.includes('access_token')){
        clearInterval(check); popup.close();
        const p=new URLSearchParams(hash.slice(1));
        _gdriveToken=p.get('access_token');
        if(_gdriveToken){
          localStorage.setItem('pp_gdrive_token',_gdriveToken);
          gdriveUpdateUI(true);
          setDriveStatus('✅ Conectado ao Google Drive','ok');
          gdriveGetUserInfo();
        }
      }
    }catch(e){}
  },500);
}

async function gdriveGetUserInfo(){
  if(!_gdriveToken)return;
  try{
    const r=await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/userinfo',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+_gdriveToken}});
    const u=await r.json();
    const el=document.getElementById('driveUserInfo');
    if(el&&u.email){el.textContent='🟢 '+u.email; el.style.display='inline';}
  }catch(e){}
}

function gdriveUpdateUI(connected){
  const connectBtn=document.getElementById('driveConnectBtn');
  const saveBtn=document.getElementById('driveSaveBtn');
  const listBtn=document.getElementById('driveListBtn');
  const disconnectBtn=document.getElementById('driveDisconnectBtn');
  const userInfo=document.getElementById('driveUserInfo');
  if(connectBtn)connectBtn.style.display=connected?'none':'';
  if(userInfo)userInfo.style.display=connected?'inline':'none';
  if(saveBtn){saveBtn.disabled=!connected; saveBtn.style.opacity=connected?'1':'.5';}
  if(listBtn){listBtn.disabled=!connected; listBtn.style.opacity=connected?'1':'.5';}
  if(disconnectBtn)disconnectBtn.style.display=connected?'':'none';
}

    if(!r.ok)throw new Error('API Key recusada pelo Google ('+r.status+')');
    const j=await r.json();
    if(!j || !j.name)throw new Error('Resposta inesperada do Google Drive API');
    setDriveStatus('✅ Configuração válida. Agora conecte ao Google Drive.','ok');
    const st=document.getElementById('gdriveIntegrationStatus');
    if(st){st.className='integrationStatus ok';st.textContent='Configuração OK';}
    showCloudToast?.('Google Drive API validada ✅','ok',4000);
  }catch(e){
    setDriveStatus('❌ Falha no teste: '+e.message,'err');
    const st=document.getElementById('gdriveIntegrationStatus');
    if(st){st.className='integrationStatus err';st.textContent='Teste falhou';}
  }
}

function gdriveConnect(){
  const clientId=gdriveClientId();
  if(!clientId){
    const hint=document.getElementById('driveClientIdHint'); if(hint)hint.style.display='';
    setDriveStatus('⚠ Google Drive não configurado. Preencha Central Administrativa → Integrações.','err');
    openAppConfirm({
      title:'Google Drive não configurado',
      message:'Para usar o Google Drive, preencha o <b>OAuth Client ID</b> e a <b>API Key</b> em <b>Central Administrativa → Integrações</b>.<br><br>Depois clique em <b>Conectar ao Google Drive</b> novamente.',
      okText:'Entendi',
      onConfirm:()=>{}
    });
    return;
  }
  const redirectUri=window.location.origin+window.location.pathname;
  const params=new URLSearchParams({
    client_id:clientId,
    redirect_uri:redirectUri,
    response_type:'token',
    scope:GDRIVE_SCOPE,
    prompt:'select_account'
  });
  const popup=window.open('https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?'+params,'gdrive_oauth','width=500,height=600,left=200,top=100');
  const check=setInterval(()=>{
    try{
      if(popup.closed){clearInterval(check);return;}
      const hash=popup.location.hash;
      if(hash&&hash.includes('access_token')){
        clearInterval(check); popup.close();
        const p=new URLSearchParams(hash.slice(1));
        _gdriveToken=p.get('access_token');
        if(_gdriveToken){
          localStorage.setItem('pp_gdrive_token',_gdriveToken);
          gdriveUpdateUI(true);
          setDriveStatus('✅ Conectado ao Google Drive','ok');
          gdriveGetUserInfo();
        }
      }
    }catch(e){}
  },500);
}

async function gdriveFindOrCreateFolder(){
  // Buscar pasta existente
  const q=encodeURIComponent(`name='${GDRIVE_FOLDER}' and mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and trashed=false`);
  const r=await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?q=${q}&fields=files(id,name)`,{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+_gdriveToken}});
  const data=await r.json();
  if(data.files&&data.files.length) return data.files[0].id;
  // Criar pasta
  const cr=await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files',{
    method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+_gdriveToken,'Content-Type':'application/json'},
    body:JSON.stringify({name:GDRIVE_FOLDER,mimeType:'application/vnd.google-apps.folder'})
  });
  const folder=await cr.json();
  return folder.id;
}

async function gdriveCleanOldBackups(folderId){
  // Listar backups existentes ordenados por data
  const q=encodeURIComponent(`'${folderId}' in parents and name contains 'portaria-primavera' and trashed=false`);
  const r=await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?q=${q}&orderBy=createdTime&fields=files(id,name,createdTime)`,{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+_gdriveToken}});
  const data=await r.json();
  const files=data.files||[];
  if(files.length>=GDRIVE_MAX_BACKUPS){
    // Apagar os mais antigos
    const toDelete=files.slice(0,files.length-GDRIVE_MAX_BACKUPS+1);
    for(const f of toDelete){
      await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${f.id}`,{method:'DELETE',headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+_gdriveToken}});
    }
  }
}

async function gdriveSaveNow(){
  if(!_gdriveToken){setDriveStatus('⚠ Conecte ao Drive primeiro.','err');return;}
  setDriveStatus('⏳ Salvando no Google Drive...');
  try{
    const folderId=await gdriveFindOrCreateFolder();
    await gdriveCleanOldBackups(folderId);
    const payload=buildBackupPayload('completo');
    const json=JSON.stringify(payload,null,2);
    const now=new Date();
    const dt=`${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}_${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')}${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
    const nome=`portaria-primavera-${dt}.json`;
    // Upload multipart
    const boundary='pp_boundary_'+Date.now();
    const meta=JSON.stringify({name:nome,parents:[folderId]});
    const body=`--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\n\r\n${meta}\r\n--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\n\r\n${json}\r\n--${boundary}--`;
    const r=await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files?uploadType=multipart',{
      method:'POST',
      headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+_gdriveToken,'Content-Type':`multipart/related; boundary=${boundary}`},
      body
    });
    if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);
    addLog('Backup Google Drive',`Arquivo: ${nome} | Checksum: ${payload.checksum}`,'backup');
    persistNoRender();
    localStorage.setItem('pp_last_gdrive_backup_at',new Date().toISOString());
    setDriveStatus(`✅ Salvo no Drive: ${nome} (checksum ${payload.checksum})`,'ok');
    refreshBackupCenterStatus?.();
    showCloudToast('Backup salvo no Google Drive ✅','ok',5000);
  }catch(e){
    setDriveStatus('❌ Erro ao salvar no Drive: '+e.message,'err');
    showCloudToast('Erro ao salvar no Google Drive','err',8000);
    if(e.message.includes('401'))gdriveDisconnect();
  }
}

async function gdriveListBackups(){
  if(!_gdriveToken){setDriveStatus('⚠ Conecte ao Drive primeiro.','err');return;}
  setDriveStatus('⏳ Buscando backups no Drive...');
  try{
    const folderId=await gdriveFindOrCreateFolder();
    const q=encodeURIComponent(`'${folderId}' in parents and name contains 'portaria-primavera' and trashed=false`);
    const r=await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?q=${q}&orderBy=createdTime desc&fields=files(id,name,createdTime,size)`,{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+_gdriveToken}});
    const data=await r.json();
    const files=data.files||[];
    if(!files.length){setDriveStatus('Nenhum backup encontrado no Drive.');return;}
    const lista=files.map((f,i)=>{
      const d=new Date(f.createdTime).toLocaleString('pt-BR');
      const kb=f.size?Math.round(f.size/1024)+'KB':'?';
      return `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:12px">
        <div><b>${f.name}</b><br><span style="color:var(--muted)">${d} · ${kb}</span></div>
        <button class="btn ghost" style="padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px" onclick="gdriveRestoreFile('${f.id}','${f.name}')">Restaurar</button>
      </div>`;
    }).join('');
    openAppConfirm({title:`Backups no Google Drive (${files.length})`,message:lista,okText:'Fechar',onConfirm:()=>{}});
    setDriveStatus(`${files.length} backup(s) encontrado(s) no Drive.`,'ok');
  }catch(e){
    setDriveStatus('❌ Erro ao listar backups: '+e.message,'err');
    if(e.message.includes('401'))gdriveDisconnect();
  }
}

async function gdriveRestoreFile(fileId,fileName){
  if(!_gdriveToken)return;
  setDriveStatus('⏳ Baixando backup do Drive...');
  try{
    const r=await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/${fileId}?alt=media`,{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+_gdriveToken}});
    const text=await r.text();
    const parsed=JSON.parse(text);
    const v=validateBackup(parsed);
    if(!v.ok){setDriveStatus('❌ '+v.msg,'err');return;}
    const info=parsed._pp_backup?`<b>Gerado em:</b> ${parsed.gerado_em_br}<br><b>Checksum:</b> ✅ verificado`:'Backup legado.';
    openAppConfirm({
      title:'Restaurar backup do Drive?',
      message:`Arquivo: <b>${fileName}</b><br>${info}<br><br>A base atual será substituída.`,
      okText:'Restaurar',
      onConfirm:()=>{createLocalSnapshot('antes-restaurar-drive',true); applyBackupData(parsed,{name:fileName}); setDriveStatus(`✅ Restaurado do Drive: ${fileName}`,'ok'); refreshBackupCenterStatus?.();}
    });
  }catch(e){
    setDriveStatus('❌ Erro ao baixar do Drive: '+e.message,'err');
    if(e.message.includes('401'))gdriveDisconnect();
  }
}

function setCloudStatus(msg){const el=document.getElementById('cloudStatus'); if(el)el.textContent=msg; try{setTimeout(()=>{refreshBackupCenterStatus?.(); refreshSyncCenterStatus?.();},80)}catch(e){}}
function cloudTodayKey(){return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}
function cloudBackupTargetToday(){const d=new Date(); d.setHours(CLOUD_BACKUP_HOUR,CLOUD_BACKUP_MINUTE,0,0); return d;}
function cloudNextTarget(){const now=new Date(); const target=cloudBackupTargetToday(); if(now>=target)target.setDate(target.getDate()+1); return target;}
function cloudTargetLabel(d){return d.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}
function cloudSnapshotPayload(reason='auto'){
  return {
    app:'Portaria Primavera',
    version:'v150',
    reason,
    saved_at:new Date().toISOString(),
    source:reason==='sync'?'pwa-sync':'pwa-localstorage',
    syncMeta:{deviceId:localDeviceId,role:(currentOperator()?.perfil||''),user:(currentOperator()?.login||''),syncAt:new Date().toISOString()},
    state:(()=>{const safe=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state||{}));if(Array.isArray(safe.users))safe.users=safe.users.map(({senha,...u})=>u);return safe;})()
  };
}

function cloudSnapshotPayload(reason='auto'){
  return {
    app:'Portaria Primavera',
    version:'v150',
    reason,
    saved_at:new Date().toISOString(),
    source:reason==='sync'?'pwa-sync':'pwa-localstorage',
    syncMeta:{deviceId:localDeviceId,role:(currentOperator()?.perfil||''),user:(currentOperator()?.login||''),syncAt:new Date().toISOString()},
    state:(()=>{const safe=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state||{}));if(Array.isArray(safe.users))safe.users=safe.users.map(({senha,...u})=>u);return safe;})()
  };

function initCloud(){
  try{
    if(!window.supabase){setCloudStatus('☁️ Nuvem indisponível: biblioteca Supabase não carregou. O app segue local.');return false;}
    supabaseClient=window.supabase.createClient(SUPABASE_URL,SUPABASE_ANON_KEY);
    cloudReady=true;
    setTimeout(setupSupabaseRecoveryListener,0);
    scheduleCloudAutoBackup(true);
    startCloudSync();
    return true;
  }catch(e){console.warn('Falha Supabase',e);setCloudStatus('☁️ Falha ao conectar Supabase. O app segue local.');return false;}
}
function scheduleCloudAutoBackup(checkCatchUp=false){
  if(!cloudReady||!supabaseClient)return;
  clearTimeout(cloudTimer);
  const today=cloudTodayKey();
  const targetToday=cloudBackupTargetToday();
  const now=new Date();
  const last=localStorage.getItem(CLOUD_DAILY_KEY)||'';

  // Se o app abriu depois das 02:00 e ainda não fez backup hoje, faz um catch-up rápido.
  if(checkCatchUp && last!==today && now>=targetToday){
    setCloudStatus('☁️ Supabase conectado. Backup diário pendente: enviando em instantes...');
    cloudTimer=setTimeout(()=>cloudSaveDailyIfNeeded(),2500);
    return;
  }

  const next=cloudNextTarget();
  const delay=Math.max(1000,next.getTime()-Date.now());
  setCloudStatus(`☁️ Supabase conectado. Backup automático diário agendado para ${cloudTargetLabel(next)}.`);
  cloudTimer=setTimeout(()=>cloudSaveDailyIfNeeded(),delay);
}
async function cloudSaveDailyIfNeeded(){
  if(!cloudReady||!supabaseClient)return;
  const today=cloudTodayKey();
  if(localStorage.getItem(CLOUD_DAILY_KEY)===today){scheduleCloudAutoBackup(false);return;}
  const ok=await cloudSaveNow('auto-diario',true);
  if(ok)localStorage.setItem(CLOUD_DAILY_KEY,today);
  scheduleCloudAutoBackup(false);
}
/* v107 — Toast de feedback do backup cloud */
let _cloudToastTimer=null;
function showCloudToast(msg,type='ok',duration=5000){
  const el=document.getElementById('cloudToast');
  const icon=document.getElementById('cloudToastIcon');
  const txt=document.getElementById('cloudToastMsg');
  if(!el||!icon||!txt)return;
  clearTimeout(_cloudToastTimer);
  icon.textContent=type==='ok'?'✅':'❌';
  txt.textContent=msg;
  el.className='show '+(type==='ok'?'ok':'err');
  _cloudToastTimer=setTimeout(()=>{el.className=el.className.replace('show','').trim()},duration);
}

async function cloudSaveNow(reason='manual',silent=false){
  if(!cloudReady&&!initCloud())return false;
  try{
    if(!silent)setCloudStatus('☁️ Enviando backup para a nuvem...');
    const isAuto=reason==='auto-diario';
    const desc=(isAuto?'Auto diário 02:00 ':'Manual ')+new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR');
    addLog(isAuto?'Backup automático diário na nuvem':'Backup manual na nuvem',desc,'backup');
    const {error}=await supabaseClient.from('snapshots').insert({descricao:desc,dados:cloudSnapshotPayload(reason)});
    if(error)throw error;
    const msg=(isAuto?'☁️ Backup automático diário salvo às ':'☁️ Backup manual salvo às ')+new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
    setCloudStatus(msg+(isAuto?' • próximo às 02:00.':''));
    const st=document.getElementById('backupStatus'); if(st&&!silent)st.textContent='Backup enviado para Supabase com sucesso.';

/* v119 — Sincronização multi-dispositivo Supabase em tempo real com permissões preservadas
   - Portaria: envia/recebe acessos e logs; recebe moradores/admin/agenda/configurações somente leitura.
   - Admin: envia/recebe todos os módulos.
   - Push após salvar, Realtime quando disponível e pull automático a cada 30s como segurança.
*/
function touchStateMeta(reason='alteracao'){
  if(!state.meta||typeof state.meta!=='object')state.meta={};
  const op=currentOperator();
  state.meta.updatedAt=new Date().toISOString();
  state.meta.updatedBy=op.login||'';
  state.meta.updatedByName=op.nome||'';
  state.meta.updatedByPerfil=op.perfil||'';
  state.meta.updateReason=reason;
}
function getAccessStamp(a){return new Date(a?.updatedAt||a?.editedAt||a?.exitAt||a?.createdAt||a?.entrada||0).getTime()||0}
function mergeById(localArr=[],remoteArr=[],stampFn=(x)=>new Date(x?.criadoEm||x?.updatedAt||x?.createdAt||0).getTime()||0,limit=1500){
  const map=new Map();
  [...(remoteArr||[]),...(localArr||[])].forEach(item=>{
    if(!item)return;
    const id=item.id||('sem-id-'+JSON.stringify(item).slice(0,80));
    const prev=map.get(id);
    if(!prev||stampFn(item)>=stampFn(prev))map.set(id,item);
  });
  return [...map.values()].sort((a,b)=>stampFn(b)-stampFn(a)).slice(0,limit);
}
function mergeDeletedAccessIds(local=[],remote=[]){
  const map=new Map();
  [...(remote||[]),...(local||[])].forEach(d=>{if(!d)return; const id=typeof d==='string'?d:d.id; if(!id)return; const prev=map.get(id); const item=typeof d==='string'?{id,deletedAt:new Date().toISOString()}:d; if(!prev||new Date(item.deletedAt||0)>=new Date(prev.deletedAt||0))map.set(id,item);});
  return [...map.values()].sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.deletedAt||0)-new Date(a.deletedAt||0)).slice(0,800);
}
function mergeStatesForSync(localState,remoteState,remoteMeta={}){
  if(!remoteState||typeof remoteState!=='object')return localState;
  const merged={...localState};
  const remoteRole=remoteMeta?.role||remoteState?.meta?.updatedByPerfil||'';
  const remoteIsPortaria=String(remoteRole).toLowerCase()==='portaria';
  const localIsPortaria=!isAdmin();

  // Acessos: sempre mão dupla, com último update vencendo por registro.
  const deleted=mergeDeletedAccessIds(localState.deletedAccessIds,remoteState.deletedAccessIds);
  const deletedIds=new Set(deleted.map(x=>x.id));
  merged.deletedAccessIds=deleted;
  merged.accesses=mergeById(localState.accesses||[],remoteState.accesses||[],getAccessStamp,2500).filter(a=>!deletedIds.has(a.id));

  // Logs: todos podem gerar; admin visualiza completo.
  merged.logs=mergeById(localState.logs||[],remoteState.logs||[],x=>new Date(x?.criadoEm||0).getTime()||0,1500);

  // Módulos administrativos: portaria nunca sobrepõe. Snapshot de portaria não manda autoridade sobre moradores/admin/config.
  if(!remoteIsPortaria){
    merged.units=remoteState.units&&typeof remoteState.units==='object'?remoteState.units:(merged.units||{});
    merged.admin=remoteState.admin&&typeof remoteState.admin==='object'?remoteState.admin:merged.admin;
    merged.operational=Array.isArray(remoteState.operational)?remoteState.operational:(merged.operational||[]);
    merged.users=mergeUsersPreservingPasswords(localState?.users,Array.isArray(remoteState.users)&&remoteState.users.length?remoteState.users:(merged.users||defaultUsers()));
    merged.settings={...(merged.settings||{}),...(remoteState.settings||{})};
    merged.passagens=mergeById(localState.passagens||[],remoteState.passagens||[],x=>new Date(x?.createdAt||x?.data||0).getTime()||0,500);
  }else if(localIsPortaria){
    // Mesmo quando o último snapshot foi feito pela portaria, ela continua recebendo esses módulos do estado remoto se existirem,
    // mas sem transformar isso em edição local; serve apenas para manter visualização consistente.
    merged.units=remoteState.units&&typeof remoteState.units==='object'?remoteState.units:(merged.units||{});
    merged.admin=remoteState.admin&&typeof remoteState.admin==='object'?remoteState.admin:merged.admin;
    merged.operational=Array.isArray(remoteState.operational)?remoteState.operational:(merged.operational||[]);
    merged.users=mergeUsersPreservingPasswords(localState?.users,Array.isArray(remoteState.users)&&remoteState.users.length?remoteState.users:(merged.users||defaultUsers()));
    merged.settings={...(merged.settings||{}),...(remoteState.settings||{})};
  }
  merged.meta={...(merged.meta||{}),lastSyncMergeAt:new Date().toISOString()};
  return merged;
}

function startCloudSync(){
  if(!cloudReady||!supabaseClient)return;
  clearInterval(syncTimer);
  syncTimer=setInterval(()=>cloudSyncPullLatest(true),CLOUD_SYNC_INTERVAL_MS);
  setupCloudRealtimeSync();
  setTimeout(()=>cloudSyncPullLatest(true),2500);
}
function setupCloudRealtimeSync(){
  if(!cloudReady||!supabaseClient||syncRealtimeChannel)return;
  try{
    syncRealtimeChannel=supabaseClient.channel('pp_snapshots_realtime_'+localDeviceId)
      .on('postgres_changes',{event:'INSERT',schema:'public',table:'snapshots'},payload=>{
        const row=payload?.new||{};
        const payloadData=row.dados||{};
        const meta=payloadData.syncMeta||{};
        const id=Number(row.id)||0;
        if(meta.deviceId&&meta.deviceId===localDeviceId){
          if(id){lastSyncSnapshotId=id;localStorage.setItem('pp_last_sync_snapshot_id',String(lastSyncSnapshotId));}
          return;
        }
        const now=Date.now();
        if(now-lastRealtimeEventAt<1200)return;
        lastRealtimeEventAt=now;
        setCloudStatus('☁️ Sync em tempo real: nova alteração detectada. Atualizando...');
        setTimeout(()=>cloudSyncPullLatest(true),450);
      })
      .subscribe(status=>{
        syncRealtimeReady=status==='SUBSCRIBED';
        if(syncRealtimeReady){
          setCloudStatus('☁️ Sync em tempo real ativo. Verificação automática a cada 30s como segurança.');
        }else if(status==='CHANNEL_ERROR'||status==='TIMED_OUT'||status==='CLOSED'){
          setCloudStatus('☁️ Sync por verificação automática ativo. Realtime indisponível no momento.');
        }
      });
  }catch(e){
    console.warn('Realtime Supabase indisponível',e);
    setCloudStatus('☁️ Sync por verificação automática ativo. Realtime indisponível no momento.');
  }
}
function queueCloudSyncPush(reason='alteracao'){

  syncPushTimer=setTimeout(()=>cloudSyncPush(reason),CLOUD_SYNC_DEBOUNCE_MS);
}
async function cloudSyncPush(reason='alteracao'){
  if(!cloudReady||!supabaseClient||syncInProgress)return false;
  try{
    syncInProgress=true; updateSyncButtonStatus?.('syncing');
    const op=currentOperator();
    const desc='Sync '+new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')+' • '+(op.nome||op.login||'sem usuário')+' • '+reason;
    const {data,error}=await supabaseClient.from('snapshots').insert({descricao:desc,dados:cloudSnapshotPayload('sync')}).select('id').single();
    if(error)throw error;
    if(data?.id){lastSyncSnapshotId=Number(data.id)||lastSyncSnapshotId;localStorage.setItem('pp_last_sync_snapshot_id',String(lastSyncSnapshotId));}
    lastSyncAt=new Date().toISOString();localStorage.setItem('pp_last_sync_at',lastSyncAt);
    setCloudStatus((syncRealtimeReady?'☁️ Sync em tempo real ativo. Último envio: ':'☁️ Sync ativo. Último envio: ')+new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}));
    return true;
  }catch(e){console.warn('Falha no sync push',e);setCloudStatus('☁️ Sync pendente. Dados locais preservados.');return false;}
  finally{syncInProgress=false; refreshSyncCenterStatus?.();}
}
async function cloudSyncPullLatest(silent=false){
  if(!cloudReady||!supabaseClient||syncInProgress)return false;
  try{
    syncInProgress=true; updateSyncButtonStatus?.('syncing');
    const {data,error}=await supabaseClient.from('snapshots').select('id,descricao,dados,criado_em').order('criado_em',{ascending:false}).limit(1);
    if(error)throw error;
    if(!data||!data.length)return false;
    const snap=data[0];
    const snapId=Number(snap.id)||0;
    if(snapId&&snapId===lastSyncSnapshotId)return false;
    const payload=snap.dados||{};
    const remoteState=payload.state||payload;
    const remoteMeta=payload.syncMeta||{};
    if(remoteMeta.deviceId&&remoteMeta.deviceId===localDeviceId){lastSyncSnapshotId=snapId;localStorage.setItem('pp_last_sync_snapshot_id',String(lastSyncSnapshotId));return false;}
    const before=JSON.stringify({a:(state.accesses||[]).length,u:Object.keys(state.units||{}).length,l:(state.logs||[]).length});
    state=mergeStatesForSync(state,remoteState,remoteMeta);
    normalizeImportedVehicles?.(); normalizeAccesses?.(); ensureSettings?.(); ensureOperational?.();
    if(!Array.isArray(state.users)||!state.users.length)state.users=defaultUsers();
    state.users.forEach(u=>{if(u.ativo===undefined)u.ativo=true});
    localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(state));
    lastSyncSnapshotId=snapId; localStorage.setItem('pp_last_sync_snapshot_id',String(lastSyncSnapshotId));
    lastSyncAt=new Date().toISOString(); localStorage.setItem('pp_last_sync_at',lastSyncAt);
    applyTheme?.(); applyPermissions?.(); renderAll?.();
    const after=JSON.stringify({a:(state.accesses||[]).length,u:Object.keys(state.units||{}).length,l:(state.logs||[]).length});
    if(before!==after&&!silent)showCloudToast('Dados atualizados pela nuvem.','ok',3500);
    setCloudStatus((syncRealtimeReady?'☁️ Sync em tempo real ativo. Atualizado às ':'☁️ Sync ativo. Atualizado às ')+new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}));
    return true;
  }catch(e){console.warn('Falha no sync pull',e); if(!silent)setCloudStatus('☁️ Não foi possível atualizar da nuvem agora.'); return false;}
  finally{syncInProgress=false; refreshSyncCenterStatus?.();}
}

async function cloudSyncPush(reason='alteracao'){
  if(!cloudReady||!supabaseClient||syncInProgress)return false;
  try{
    syncInProgress=true; updateSyncButtonStatus?.('syncing');
    const op=currentOperator();
    const desc='Sync '+new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR')+' • '+(op.nome||op.login||'sem usuário')+' • '+reason;
    const {data,error}=await supabaseClient.from('snapshots').insert({descricao:desc,dados:cloudSnapshotPayload('sync')}).select('id').single();
    if(error)throw error;
    if(data?.id){lastSyncSnapshotId=Number(data.id)||lastSyncSnapshotId;localStorage.setItem('pp_last_sync_snapshot_id',String(lastSyncSnapshotId));}
    lastSyncAt=new Date().toISOString();localStorage.setItem('pp_last_sync_at',lastSyncAt);
    setCloudStatus((syncRealtimeReady?'☁️ Sync em tempo real ativo. Último envio: ':'☁️ Sync ativo. Último envio: ')+new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}));
    return true;
  }catch(e){console.warn('Falha no sync push',e);setCloudStatus('☁️ Sync pendente. Dados locais preservados.');return false;}
  finally{syncInProgress=false; refreshSyncCenterStatus?.();}
}
async function cloudSyncPullLatest(silent=false){
  if(!cloudReady||!supabaseClient||syncInProgress)return false;
  try{
    syncInProgress=true; updateSyncButtonStatus?.('syncing');
    const {data,error}=await supabaseClient.from('snapshots').select('id,descricao,dados,criado_em').order('criado_em',{ascending:false}).limit(1);
    if(error)throw error;
    if(!data||!data.length)return false;
    const snap=data[0];
    const snapId=Number(snap.id)||0;
    if(snapId&&snapId===lastSyncSnapshotId)return false;
    const payload=snap.dados||{};
    const remoteState=payload.state||payload;
    const remoteMeta=payload.syncMeta||{};
    if(remoteMeta.deviceId&&remoteMeta.deviceId===localDeviceId){lastSyncSnapshotId=snapId;localStorage.setItem('pp_last_sync_snapshot_id',String(lastSyncSnapshotId));return false;}
    const before=JSON.stringify({a:(state.accesses||[]).length,u:Object.keys(state.units||{}).length,l:(state.logs||[]).length});
    state=mergeStatesForSync(state,remoteState,remoteMeta);
    normalizeImportedVehicles?.(); normalizeAccesses?.(); ensureSettings?.(); ensureOperational?.();
    if(!Array.isArray(state.users)||!state.users.length)state.users=defaultUsers();
    state.users.forEach(u=>{if(u.ativo===undefined)u.ativo=true});
    localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(state));
    lastSyncSnapshotId=snapId; localStorage.setItem('pp_last_sync_snapshot_id',String(lastSyncSnapshotId));
    lastSyncAt=new Date().toISOString(); localStorage.setItem('pp_last_sync_at',lastSyncAt);
    applyTheme?.(); applyPermissions?.(); renderAll?.();
    const after=JSON.stringify({a:(state.accesses||[]).length,u:Object.keys(state.units||{}).length,l:(state.logs||[]).length});
    if(before!==after&&!silent)showCloudToast('Dados atualizados pela nuvem.','ok',3500);
    setCloudStatus((syncRealtimeReady?'☁️ Sync em tempo real ativo. Atualizado às ':'☁️ Sync ativo. Atualizado às ')+new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}));
    return true;
  }catch(e){console.warn('Falha no sync pull',e); if(!silent)setCloudStatus('☁️ Não foi possível atualizar da nuvem agora.'); return false;}
  finally{syncInProgress=false; refreshSyncCenterStatus?.();}
}

async function cloudSyncPullLatest(silent=false){
  if(!cloudReady||!supabaseClient||syncInProgress)return false;
  try{
    syncInProgress=true; updateSyncButtonStatus?.('syncing');
    const {data,error}=await supabaseClient.from('snapshots').select('id,descricao,dados,criado_em').order('criado_em',{ascending:false}).limit(1);
    if(error)throw error;
    if(!data||!data.length)return false;
    const snap=data[0];
    const snapId=Number(snap.id)||0;
    if(snapId&&snapId===lastSyncSnapshotId)return false;
    const payload=snap.dados||{};
    const remoteState=payload.state||payload;
    const remoteMeta=payload.syncMeta||{};
    if(remoteMeta.deviceId&&remoteMeta.deviceId===localDeviceId){lastSyncSnapshotId=snapId;localStorage.setItem('pp_last_sync_snapshot_id',String(lastSyncSnapshotId));return false;}
    const before=JSON.stringify({a:(state.accesses||[]).length,u:Object.keys(state.units||{}).length,l:(state.logs||[]).length});
    state=mergeStatesForSync(state,remoteState,remoteMeta);
    normalizeImportedVehicles?.(); normalizeAccesses?.(); ensureSettings?.(); ensureOperational?.();
    if(!Array.isArray(state.users)||!state.users.length)state.users=defaultUsers();
    state.users.forEach(u=>{if(u.ativo===undefined)u.ativo=true});
    localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(state));
    lastSyncSnapshotId=snapId; localStorage.setItem('pp_last_sync_snapshot_id',String(lastSyncSnapshotId));
    lastSyncAt=new Date().toISOString(); localStorage.setItem('pp_last_sync_at',lastSyncAt);
    applyTheme?.(); applyPermissions?.(); renderAll?.();
    const after=JSON.stringify({a:(state.accesses||[]).length,u:Object.keys(state.units||{}).length,l:(state.logs||[]).length});
    if(before!==after&&!silent)showCloudToast('Dados atualizados pela nuvem.','ok',3500);
    setCloudStatus((syncRealtimeReady?'☁️ Sync em tempo real ativo. Atualizado às ':'☁️ Sync ativo. Atualizado às ')+new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}));
    return true;
  }catch(e){console.warn('Falha no sync pull',e); if(!silent)setCloudStatus('☁️ Não foi possível atualizar da nuvem agora.'); return false;}
  finally{syncInProgress=false; refreshSyncCenterStatus?.();}
}
function atualizarDaNuvemAgora(){cloudSyncPullLatest(false).then(ok=>{showCloudToast(ok?'Dados atualizados pela nuvem.':'Nenhuma atualização nova encontrada.','ok',3500); refreshBackupCenterStatus?.();})}

function updateTopbarClockGreeting(){
  const now=new Date();
  const h=now.getHours();
  const meta=document.getElementById('topMeta');
  const greet=document.getElementById('topGreeting');
  const hora=now.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
  const data=now.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{weekday:'short',day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit'}).replace('.', '');
  if(meta)meta.textContent=`${hora} • ${data}`;
  const u=getCurrentUser?getCurrentUser():null;
  const nome=(u&&(u.nome||u.login)||'').split(' ')[0]||'visitante';
  const saud=h<12?'Bom dia':h<18?'Boa tarde':'Boa noite';
  if(greet)greet.textContent=`${saud}, ${nome}.`;
}

function isKioskMode(){return document.body.classList.contains('kiosk-mode')}
function updateKioskButton(){
  const btn=document.getElementById('kioskBtn');
  if(!btn)return;
  const on=isKioskMode();
  btn.textContent='⛶';
  btn.title=on?'Sair do modo kiosk':'Ativar modo kiosk';
  btn.setAttribute('aria-label', on?'Sair do modo kiosk':'Ativar modo kiosk');
}
async function enterKioskMode(){
  document.body.classList.add('kiosk-mode');
  try{localStorage.setItem('pp_kiosk_mode','1')}catch(e){}
  try{
    if(document.documentElement.requestFullscreen && !document.fullscreenElement){
      await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
    }
  }catch(e){console.warn('Fullscreen não disponível ou bloqueado pelo navegador.',e)}
  updateKioskButton();
}
async function exitKioskMode(){
  document.body.classList.remove('kiosk-mode');
  try{localStorage.setItem('pp_kiosk_mode','0')}catch(e){}
  try{
    if(document.fullscreenElement && document.exitFullscreen){
      await document.exitFullscreen();
    }
  }catch(e){console.warn('Não foi possível sair do fullscreen pelo script.',e)}
  updateKioskButton();
}
function toggleKioskMode(){
  if(isKioskMode()) exitKioskMode();
  else enterKioskMode();
}
document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange',()=>{
  if(!document.fullscreenElement && isKioskMode()){
    document.body.classList.remove('kiosk-mode');
    try{localStorage.setItem('pp_kiosk_mode','0')}catch(e){}
  }
  updateKioskButton();
});
document.addEventListener('keydown',(ev)=>{
  if(isKioskMode() && (ev.key==='F11' || (ev.altKey && ev.key==='F4'))){
    ev.preventDefault();
  }
});

function updateTopbarClockGreeting(){
  const now=new Date();
  const h=now.getHours();
  const meta=document.getElementById('topMeta');
  const greet=document.getElementById('topGreeting');
  const hora=now.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
  const data=now.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{weekday:'short',day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit'}).replace('.', '');
  if(meta)meta.textContent=`${hora} • ${data}`;
  const u=getCurrentUser?getCurrentUser():null;
  const nome=(u&&(u.nome||u.login)||'').split(' ')[0]||'visitante';
  const saud=h<12?'Bom dia':h<18?'Boa tarde':'Boa noite';
  if(greet)greet.textContent=`${saud}, ${nome}.`;
}
setInterval(updateTopbarClockGreeting,30000);

function isKioskMode(){return document.body.classList.contains('kiosk-mode')}
function updateKioskButton(){
  const btn=document.getElementById('kioskBtn');
  if(!btn)return;
  const on=isKioskMode();
  btn.textContent='⛶';
  btn.title=on?'Sair do modo kiosk':'Ativar modo kiosk';
  btn.setAttribute('aria-label', on?'Sair do modo kiosk':'Ativar modo kiosk');
}
async function enterKioskMode(){
  document.body.classList.add('kiosk-mode');
  try{localStorage.setItem('pp_kiosk_mode','1')}catch(e){}
  try{
    if(document.documentElement.requestFullscreen && !document.fullscreenElement){
      await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
    }
  }catch(e){console.warn('Fullscreen não disponível ou bloqueado pelo navegador.',e)}
  updateKioskButton();
}
async function exitKioskMode(){
  document.body.classList.remove('kiosk-mode');
  try{localStorage.setItem('pp_kiosk_mode','0')}catch(e){}
  try{
    if(document.fullscreenElement && document.exitFullscreen){
      await document.exitFullscreen();
    }
  }catch(e){console.warn('Não foi possível sair do fullscreen pelo script.',e)}
  updateKioskButton();
}
function toggleKioskMode(){
  if(isKioskMode()) exitKioskMode();
  else enterKioskMode();
}
document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange',()=>{
  if(!document.fullscreenElement && isKioskMode()){
    document.body.classList.remove('kiosk-mode');
    try{localStorage.setItem('pp_kiosk_mode','0')}catch(e){}
  }
  updateKioskButton();
});
document.addEventListener('keydown',(ev)=>{
  if(isKioskMode() && (ev.key==='F11' || (ev.altKey && ev.key==='F4'))){
    ev.preventDefault();
  }
});

async function completePasswordReset(){
  const p1=document.getElementById('resetNewPassword')?.value||'';
  const p2=document.getElementById('resetNewPassword2')?.value||'';
  const info=document.getElementById('resetPasswordInfo');
  if(p1.length<6){if(info)info.textContent='Use pelo menos 6 caracteres.';return;}
  if(p1!==p2){if(info)info.textContent='As senhas não coincidem.';return;}
  try{
    if(!cloudReady&&!initCloud())throw new Error('Supabase indisponível');
    const {error}=await supabaseClient.auth.updateUser({password:p1});
    if(error)throw error;
    const email=passwordRecoverySessionEmail;
    const u=(state.users||[]).find(x=>String(x.email||'').trim().toLowerCase()===email);
    if(!u)throw new Error('Usuário local não encontrado para este e-mail');
    u.senha=p1;u.authRecoveryEnabled=true;u.authRecoveryPending=false;u.authRecoveryVerifiedAt=new Date().toISOString();
    addLog('Redefiniu senha por e-mail',u.nome+' • '+maskRecoveryEmail(email),'usuario');
    save();
    try{await supabaseClient.auth.signOut()}catch(e){}
    try{history.replaceState(null,'',location.pathname+location.search)}catch(e){}
    document.getElementById('passwordResetModal')?.classList.remove('show');
    const lu=document.getElementById('loginUser'); if(lu)lu.value=u.login||'';
    const lp=document.getElementById('loginPass'); if(lp)lp.value='';
    openAppConfirm({title:'Senha atualizada',message:'✓ Sua senha foi redefinida com sucesso. Use a nova senha para entrar no Portaria.',okText:'OK'});
  }catch(e){
    console.warn('Falha ao concluir redefinição',e);
    if(info)info.textContent='Não foi possível salvar a nova senha. '+(e?.message||'Tente novamente.');
  }
}

function maskRecoveryEmail(email=''){
  const [name,domain]=String(email).split('@'); if(!domain)return '';
  const shown=name.length<=2?name[0]||'*':name.slice(0,2);
  return shown+'***@'+domain;
}
let recoveryCooldownTimer=null;
let recoveryCooldownUntil=0;
function startRecoveryCooldown(seconds=60,message='E-mail solicitado. Aguarde antes de pedir novamente.'){
  recoveryCooldownUntil=Date.now()+(Math.max(1,seconds)*1000);
  const btn=document.getElementById('recoveryContinueBtn');
  const info=document.getElementById('recoveryInfo');
  if(recoveryCooldownTimer)clearInterval(recoveryCooldownTimer);
  const tick=()=>{
    const left=Math.max(0,Math.ceil((recoveryCooldownUntil-Date.now())/1000));
    if(btn){btn.disabled=left>0;btn.textContent=left>0?'Aguarde '+left+'s':'Continuar';}
    if(info&&left>0)info.textContent=message+' Liberação em '+left+'s.';
    if(left<=0){clearInterval(recoveryCooldownTimer);recoveryCooldownTimer=null;if(info)info.textContent='Você já pode solicitar um novo e-mail de recuperação.';}
  };
  tick();recoveryCooldownTimer=setInterval(tick,1000);
}

async function completePasswordReset(){
  const p1=document.getElementById('resetNewPassword')?.value||'';
  const p2=document.getElementById('resetNewPassword2')?.value||'';
  const info=document.getElementById('resetPasswordInfo');
  if(p1.length<6){if(info)info.textContent='Use pelo menos 6 caracteres.';return;}
  if(p1!==p2){if(info)info.textContent='As senhas não coincidem.';return;}
  try{
    if(!cloudReady&&!initCloud())throw new Error('Supabase indisponível');
    const {error}=await supabaseClient.auth.updateUser({password:p1});
    if(error)throw error;
    const email=passwordRecoverySessionEmail;
    const u=(state.users||[]).find(x=>String(x.email||'').trim().toLowerCase()===email);
    if(!u)throw new Error('Usuário local não encontrado para este e-mail');
    u.senha=p1;u.authRecoveryEnabled=true;u.authRecoveryPending=false;u.authRecoveryVerifiedAt=new Date().toISOString();
    addLog('Redefiniu senha por e-mail',u.nome+' • '+maskRecoveryEmail(email),'usuario');
    save();
    try{await supabaseClient.auth.signOut()}catch(e){}
    try{history.replaceState(null,'',location.pathname+location.search)}catch(e){}
    document.getElementById('passwordResetModal')?.classList.remove('show');
    const lu=document.getElementById('loginUser'); if(lu)lu.value=u.login||'';
    const lp=document.getElementById('loginPass'); if(lp)lp.value='';
    openAppConfirm({title:'Senha atualizada',message:'✓ Sua senha foi redefinida com sucesso. Use a nova senha para entrar no Portaria.',okText:'OK'});
  }catch(e){
    console.warn('Falha ao concluir redefinição',e);
    if(info)info.textContent='Não foi possível salvar a nova senha. '+(e?.message||'Tente novamente.');
  }
}
function setupSupabaseRecoveryListener(){
  try{
    if(!supabaseClient)return;
    supabaseClient.auth.onAuthStateChange((event,session)=>{
      if(event==='PASSWORD_RECOVERY'&&session)openPasswordResetFromRecovery(session);
    });
    supabaseClient.auth.getSession().then(({data})=>{
      const hash=String(location.hash||'');
      if(data?.session&&(/type=recovery/i.test(hash)||/access_token=/i.test(hash)))openPasswordResetFromRecovery(data.session);
    }).catch(()=>{});
  }catch(e){console.warn('Falha listener recuperação',e)}
}

  recoveryCooldownUntil=Date.now()+(Math.max(1,seconds)*1000);
  const btn=document.getElementById('recoveryContinueBtn');

  };
  tick();recoveryCooldownTimer=setInterval(tick,1000);
}

/* Máscaras automáticas — CPF e telefone/celular */
function digitsOnly(value){return String(value||'').replace(/\D+/g,'')}
function maskCPF(value){
  const d=digitsOnly(value).slice(0,11);
  if(d.length<=3)return d;
  if(d.length<=6)return d.replace(/(\d{3})(\d+)/,'$1.$2');
  if(d.length<=9)return d.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d+)/,'$1.$2.$3');
  return d.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{0,2})/,'$1.$2.$3-$4');
}
function maskPhone(value){
  const d=digitsOnly(value).slice(0,11);
  if(!d)return '';
  if(d.length<=2)return '('+d;
  if(d.length<=6)return d.replace(/(\d{2})(\d+)/,'($1) $2');
  if(d.length<=10)return d.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{4})(\d+)/,'($1) $2-$3');
  return d.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{5})(\d{0,4})/,'($1) $2-$3');
}
function isPhoneMaskField(el){
  if(!el||el.tagName!=='INPUT')return false;
  const id=(el.id||'').toLowerCase();
  const data=(el.dataset?.p||'').toLowerCase();
  return data==='cel'||id.includes('fixo')||id.includes('telefone')||id.includes('phone')||id.includes('celular');
}
function applyInputMasks(ev){
  const el=ev.target;
  if(!el||el.tagName!=='INPUT')return;
  if(isPhoneMaskField(el)){
    el.value=maskPhone(el.value);
    try{el.setSelectionRange(el.value.length,el.value.length)}catch(e){}
  }
}
function initInputMasks(){
  document.addEventListener('input',applyInputMasks,true);
  document.querySelectorAll('input[id*="Fixo"], input[id*="Telefone"], input[data-p="cel"]').forEach(el=>{el.setAttribute('inputmode','tel');el.setAttribute('autocomplete','tel');});
}

  const remember=document.getElementById('rememberLoginUser');

function reportPeriodRange(){
  const days=Number(document.getElementById('reportPeriod')?.value||30);
  if(!days)return {days:0,since:0,label:'Todo o histórico'};
  return {days,since:Date.now()-days*86400000,label:`Últimos ${days} dias`};
}
function parseDateMs(v){const d=new Date(v||0); return isNaN(d.getTime())?0:d.getTime()}
function accessMs(a){return parseDateMs(a?.entrada||((a?.data||'')+'T'+(a?.entradaHora||'00:00')))}
function opMs(o){return parseDateMs((o?.data||'')+'T00:00:00')}
function inReportRange(ms,since){return !since || ms>=since}
function topCounts(items,getKey,limit=5){
  const map=new Map();
  items.forEach(item=>{const key=(getKey(item)||'').trim(); if(!key||key==='—')return; map.set(key,(map.get(key)||0)+1)});
  return [...map.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]||a[0].localeCompare(b[0])).slice(0,limit);
}
function countResidents(){
  const units=Object.values(state.units||{});
  const people=units.flatMap(u=>Array.isArray(u.people)?u.people:[]).filter(p=>p&&p.nome);
  const app=people.filter(p=>String(p.app||'').toLowerCase()==='sim'||p.app===true).length;
  const bio=people.filter(p=>String(p.bio||'').toLowerCase()==='sim'||p.bio===true).length;
  const vehicles=units.flatMap(u=>Array.isArray(u.vehicles)?u.vehicles:[]).filter(v=>v&&(v.placa||v.modelo||v.cor||v.vaga));
  return {units,people,totalPeople:people.length,app,bio,vehicles:vehicles.length,occupied:units.filter(u=>(u.people||[]).some(p=>p.nome)).length};
}

function reportAccordion(key, icon, title, desc, badges, body, openDefault=false){
  const mem=getReportAccordionMemory();
  const isOpen = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(mem,key) ? !!mem[key] : !!openDefault;
  const badgeHtml=(badges||[]).filter(Boolean).map(b=>`<span class="reportAccordionBadge">${esc(b)}</span>`).join('');
  return `<section class="reportAccordion ${isOpen?'open':'collapsed'}" data-report-accordion="${esc(key)}">
    <div class="reportAccordionTop" onclick="toggleReportAccordion('${esc(key)}')">
      <div class="reportAccordionTitle">
        <div class="reportAccordionIcon">${icon}</div>
        <div><h3>${esc(title)}</h3><p>${esc(desc)}</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="reportAccordionSummary">${badgeHtml}<button class="reportAccordionChevron" type="button" onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleReportAccordion('${esc(key)}')">▾</button></div>
    </div>
    <div class="reportAccordionBody">${body}</div>
  </section>`;
}
function toggleReportAccordion(key){
  const card=document.querySelector(`[data-report-accordion="${CSS.escape(key)}"]`);
  if(!card)return;
  card.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  card.classList.toggle('open',!card.classList.contains('collapsed'));
  const mem=getReportAccordionMemory();
  mem[key]=!card.classList.contains('collapsed');
  setReportAccordionMemory(mem);
}

function initCondoPopover(){
  const brand=document.querySelector('.brand.v55Brand')||document.querySelector('.brand');
  if(!brand||brand.dataset.popoverReady==='1')return;
  brand.dataset.popoverReady='1';
  brand.setAttribute('title','Clique para abrir a ficha rápida do condomínio');
  brand.setAttribute('role','button');
  brand.setAttribute('tabindex','0');

  const closePopover=()=>document.getElementById('condoIdentityPopover')?.classList.remove('show');

  brand.addEventListener('click',(ev)=>{
    ev.preventDefault();
    ev.stopPropagation();
    const pop=renderCondoPopover();
    positionCondoPopover();
    pop.classList.toggle('show');
  });

  brand.addEventListener('keydown',(ev)=>{
    if(ev.key==='Enter'||ev.key===' '){
      ev.preventDefault();
      const pop=renderCondoPopover();
      positionCondoPopover();
      pop.classList.toggle('show');
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('click',(ev)=>{
    const pop=document.getElementById('condoIdentityPopover');
    if(pop&&pop.classList.contains('show')&&!pop.contains(ev.target)&&!brand.contains(ev.target))closePopover();
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize',positionCondoPopover);
  window.addEventListener('scroll',positionCondoPopover,true);
  document.addEventListener('keydown',(ev)=>{if(ev.key==='Escape')closePopover();});
}

/* v137.6 — Correção crítica: helper de texto seguro da Central
   A v137.5 usava escapeHtml() nos cards da Central, mas esse helper não existia
   no arquivo base. Isso interrompia o render da lista de comunicados ativos. */
function escapeHtml(v){
  return String(v ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(ch){
    return ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'})[ch];
  });
}

}

// desktopWheelScrollFallback — garante rolagem vertical pela rodinha no PWA instalado
(function(){
  function canScrollY(el,dy){
    if(!el || el===document.body || el===document.documentElement) return false;
    const cs=getComputedStyle(el);
    if(!/(auto|scroll)/.test(cs.overflowY)) return false;
    if(el.scrollHeight<=el.clientHeight+1) return false;
    if(dy<0) return el.scrollTop>0;
    if(dy>0) return el.scrollTop+el.clientHeight<el.scrollHeight-1;
    return false;
  }
  document.addEventListener('wheel',function(ev){
    if(ev.ctrlKey || !ev.deltaY) return;
    let el=ev.target instanceof Element ? ev.target : null;
    while(el && el!==document.body){
      if(canScrollY(el,ev.deltaY)) return;
      el=el.parentElement;
    }
    const doc=document.scrollingElement||document.documentElement;
    if(doc.scrollHeight<=doc.clientHeight+1) return;
    ev.preventDefault();
    window.scrollBy({top:ev.deltaY,left:0,behavior:'auto'});
  },{passive:false});
})();

function defaultUsers(){return[{id:'u-admin',nome:'Administrador',login:'admin',email:'c.edu.cunha1977@gmail.com',senha:'admin123',perfil:'admin',turno:'administracao',ativo:true,authRecoveryEnabled:false,authRecoveryPending:false},{id:'u-portaria-dia',nome:'Portaria Dia',login:'portaria',senha:'1234',perfil:'portaria',turno:'dia',ativo:true},{id:'u-portaria-noite',nome:'Portaria Noite',login:'portaria-noite',senha:'1234',perfil:'portaria',turno:'noite',ativo:true},{id:'u-zelador',nome:'Zelador',login:'zelador',senha:'1234',perfil:'zelador',turno:'zeladoria',ativo:true}]}
function repairLocalUserPasswords(users){
  const defaults=defaultUsers();
  const byId=new Map(defaults.map(u=>[u.id,u]));
  const byLogin=new Map(defaults.map(u=>[u.login,u]));
  return (Array.isArray(users)?users:[]).map(u=>{
    if(u&&String(u.senha||'')!=='')return u;
    const d=byId.get(u?.id)||byLogin.get(u?.login);
    return d?{...u,senha:d.senha}:u;
  });
}
function mergeUsersPreservingPasswords(localUsers,remoteUsers){
  const local=Array.isArray(localUsers)?localUsers:[];
  const remote=Array.isArray(remoteUsers)?remoteUsers:[];
  if(!remote.length)return repairLocalUserPasswords(local.length?local:defaultUsers());
  const localById=new Map(local.filter(Boolean).map(u=>[u.id,u]));
  const localByLogin=new Map(local.filter(Boolean).map(u=>[u.login,u]));
  return repairLocalUserPasswords(remote.map(r=>{
    const l=localById.get(r?.id)||localByLogin.get(r?.login);
    return {...r,...(l&&String(l.senha||'')!==''?{senha:l.senha}:{})};
  }));
}

function initial(){return{accesses:[],units:{},settings:{theme:'auto'},operational:[],users:defaultUsers(),logs:[],passagens:[],comunicados:[]}}
function load(){
  try{
    const raw=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY))||{};
    const base=initial();
    const data={...base,...raw};
    data.accesses=Array.isArray(data.accesses)?data.accesses:[];
    data.units=data.units&&typeof data.units==='object'?data.units:{};
    data.settings={...base.settings,...(data.settings||{})};
    data.operational=Array.isArray(data.operational)?data.operational:[];
    data.users=repairLocalUserPasswords(Array.isArray(data.users)&&data.users.length?data.users:defaultUsers());
    const migratedAdmin=data.users.find(u=>u&&(u.id==='u-admin'||u.login==='admin')); if(migratedAdmin&&!String(migratedAdmin.email||'').trim())migratedAdmin.email='c.edu.cunha1977@gmail.com';
    data.logs=Array.isArray(data.logs)?data.logs:[];
    data.comunicados=Array.isArray(data.comunicados)?data.comunicados:[];
    data.users.forEach(u=>normalizeUserOperational(u));
    return data;
  }catch(e){console.warn('Falha ao carregar base local',e);return initial()}
}
function save(syncReason='alteracao'){
  normalizeAccesses();
  touchStateMeta(syncReason);
  localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(state));
  const st=document.getElementById('saveStatus');
  if(st)st.textContent='Salvo às '+new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
  renderAll();
  scheduleCloudAutoBackup();
  queueCloudSyncPush(syncReason);
}

  }

}

  return u;
}

function mergeUsersPreservingPasswords(localUsers,remoteUsers){
  const local=Array.isArray(localUsers)?localUsers:[];
  const remote=Array.isArray(remoteUsers)?remoteUsers:[];
  if(!remote.length)return repairLocalUserPasswords(local.length?local:defaultUsers());
  const localById=new Map(local.filter(Boolean).map(u=>[u.id,u]));
  const localByLogin=new Map(local.filter(Boolean).map(u=>[u.login,u]));
  return repairLocalUserPasswords(remote.map(r=>{
    const l=localById.get(r?.id)||localByLogin.get(r?.login);
    return {...r,...(l&&String(l.senha||'')!==''?{senha:l.senha}:{})};
  }));
}

function load(){

    const data={...base,...raw};
    data.accesses=Array.isArray(data.accesses)?data.accesses:[];
    data.units=data.units&&typeof data.units==='object'?data.units:{};
    data.settings={...base.settings,...(data.settings||{})};
    data.operational=Array.isArray(data.operational)?data.operational:[];
    data.users=repairLocalUserPasswords(Array.isArray(data.users)&&data.users.length?data.users:defaultUsers());
    const migratedAdmin=data.users.find(u=>u&&(u.id==='u-admin'||u.login==='admin')); if(migratedAdmin&&!String(migratedAdmin.email||'').trim())migratedAdmin.email='c.edu.cunha1977@gmail.com';
    data.logs=Array.isArray(data.logs)?data.logs:[];
    data.comunicados=Array.isArray(data.comunicados)?data.comunicados:[];
    data.users.forEach(u=>normalizeUserOperational(u));
    return data;
  }catch(e){console.warn('Falha ao carregar base local',e);return initial()}
}

const ROTATION_KEY='pp_last_rotation';
const ROTATION_ACCESSES_DAYS=90;  // acessos concluídos mais antigos que isso saem do localStorage
const ROTATION_LOGS_MAX=1200;     // máximo de logs no localStorage
const ROTATION_LOGS_DAYS=180;     // logs mais antigos que isso são descartados

/* Calcula tamanho do localStorage em uso pelo app */
function storageUsedKB(){
  try{
    const raw=localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'{}';
    return Math.round(raw.length/1024);
  }catch(e){return 0}
}

/* Calcula tamanho estimado total do localStorage (todos os apps) */
function storageTotalKB(){
  try{
    let total=0;
    for(let k in localStorage) if(localStorage.hasOwnProperty(k)) total+=localStorage[k].length+k.length;
    return Math.round(total/1024);
  }catch(e){return 0}
}

/* Renderiza o painel de saúde */
function renderStorageHealth(){

  const cor=pct>80?'#a32636':pct>50?'#d58a00':'#08734d';
  const barColor=pct>80?'linear-gradient(90deg,#cc3344,#a32636)':pct>50?'linear-gradient(90deg,#d58a00,#b37200)':'linear-gradient(90deg,#0f9f6e,#08734d)';

  body.innerHTML=`
    <div style="border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;background:#fff">
      <div style="font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:900;margin-bottom:4px">Uso do storage</div>
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:${cor}">${used} KB</div>
      <div style="height:5px;border-radius:999px;background:#e5e7ef;margin-top:6px;overflow:hidden">
